reports.title: Q3 2026 Upstate NY cabin with views of fall foliage

lines: Q4 2026 • We expect to generate revenue of $3.22 billion to $3.28 billion, representing year-over-year growth of 16% to 18%, inclusive of an approximate two percentage point FX tailwind after factoring in our hedging program.
Adjusted EBITDA Margin in Q3 2026 was 52%, compared to 50% in Q3 2025.5 For the full-year 2026, we expect our effective tax rate to be in the mid-teens.
